title: FIPS gate rejection in ioctl_init discards gate return value before logging
description: fd.c:756-764: ret = ops->fips_gate() captures the gate return value, but the pr_err at line 759 does not include ret in its format string. Then ret = -EACCES overwrites the original value. The wolfCrypt-specific status (FIPS_DEGRADED_E, FIPS_FAILED_E, etc.) logged by wolfssl_provider.c:34 (rate-limited) may not appear together with the framework log in the ring buffer. At the framework level, the distinction between degraded and failed is lost. Fix: add %d for ret to the pr_err format at fd.c:759 before overwriting ret.
